implemented_routines.name: decode evaluator token
implemented_routines.scope: returned value and category for every input byte and calculation context

implemented_routines.name: classify display token
implemented_routines.scope: returned category for every input byte

implemented_routines.name: classify display construct
implemented_routines.scope: returned category for every input byte

implemented_routines.name: evaluate expression
implemented_routines.scope: COMP literals, scientific input, e/pi, parentheses, unary signs, arithmetic and stronger implicit multiplication, compact/mixed fractions, square/cube/nth roots, general real powers, factorial/percent/nPr/nCr, forward/inverse trigonometric and hyperbolic functions, ln/log10/arbitrary-base logarithm and exp/exp10; native status, both numeric records, consumed pointer, operation cleanup and nested expression-to-LCD checks; shared COMP/CMPLX grammar with imaginary-unit token, rectangular arithmetic, complex fractions, restricted complex powers, conjugation/magnitude/argument, function admission and native error cursor; ordinary scalar variables M/Ans/A..F/X/Y, terminal stores and M+/M- transactions; COMP scalar absolute/conjugate/argument and finite sum/product bodies with native X restoration, preflight/bounds/error cursors and host cancellation; adaptive integral and Richardson derivative expression bodies, default/explicit tolerances, native sampled-X and cancellation order, error cursor restoration and error-valued loads; BASE-N all-four-radix literals/prefixes, stored-value preparation, NOT/Neg/logical precedence and native arithmetic range/truncation; scalar scientific constants, DMS literal-component grammar and direct/dynamic conversion postfix admission

implemented_routines.name: post-operation numeric cleanup
implemented_routines.scope: Native post-operation cleanup for supported COMP and CMPLX arithmetic, respecting scalar header/class rules

implemented_routines.name: forward trigonometric dispatch
implemented_routines.scope: degree/radian/grad settings, numeric cores, special-result replacement and operation cleanup

implemented_routines.name: real power dispatch
implemented_routines.scope: General real decimal/rational powers, exact rational integer reconstruction, negative-base odd-denominator recognition, fast reciprocal/square/cube; full expression in implicit exponent parentheses, optional closing token and native error consumed pointer

implemented_routines.name: explicit angle-unit postfix
implemented_routines.scope: degree/radian/grad source unit to current configured unit, error cursor position

implemented_routines.name: inverse trigonometric and logarithmic function dispatch
implemented_routines.scope: RawB0/B1/B2 asin/acos/atan in all angle units; raw68 single-argument log10 and two-argument base/argument logarithm, A3 ln; nested arguments, domain/syntax errors and native consumed cursor

implemented_routines.name: hyperbolic and exponential function dispatch
implemented_routines.scope: Raw70/71/72 sinh/cosh/tanh,90/91/92 asinh/acosh/atanh,73 exp and93 exp10, operation cleanup and domain-error cursor semantics

implemented_routines.name: cube-root and nth-root dispatch
implemented_routines.scope: RawA8 unary cube root; raw9F infix degree with implicit full radicand argument, optional closing token, negative-degree precedence and error cursor

implemented_routines.name: factorial, permutation, combination and percent dispatch
implemented_routines.scope: Raw57/25 postfix and BE/BF binary operators; native precedence against fractions, implicit multiplication, powers and unary signs; operation cleanup and domain-error cursor

implemented_routines.name: ordinary variables and terminal stores
implemented_routines.scope: Prepared COMP/CMPLX scalar bank, all load/store tokens, Math-off compact-surd conversion, transactional stores and M+/M- original-value return

implemented_routines.name: finite sum/product expression orchestration
implemented_routines.scope: Shared COMP grammar for syntax preflight, separate bound evaluation and repeated local-X body evaluation; native callback order, cleanup, errors, cancellation polls and global-X restoration

implemented_routines.name: continuous-calculus expression orchestration
implemented_routines.scope: Prepared ordinary COMP syntax preflight, separate bound/point/tolerance expressions and shared body callbacks; local-X restoration, callback-success channel independent of error records, and matrix/vector reference cleanup against explicit typed bank dimensions and cells

implemented_routines.name: fraction constructor marker policy
implemented_routines.scope: Clear bit40 from numerator, denominator and restored mixed whole before complex/integer admission or ordinary fractional division; fraction constructors bypass BASE-N pending arithmetic range/truncation

implemented_routines.name: DMS, conversion and constant token handlers
implemented_routines.scope: Prepared C1/C4 and DEC BASE-N expression dispatch; completed operand admission, literal-only minutes/seconds, bounded third component, all40 direct conversions, disabled three-digit selector and exact scientific-constant record copies
